trans-unit.source: Further failures will not trigger another email for 60 minutes.

trans-unit.source: Every failure is listed in the Contao system log (System > System log). Technical details are in the application log of the installation (var/logs).

trans-unit.source: Sent by the Contao OpenAI Assistant extension. You can change or switch off these notifications in the Contao backend under AI Tools > OpenAI Dashboard > edit the configuration > section "Administrator notifications".

trans-unit.source: The chatbot on %1$s has reached its daily limit of %2$s messages.
trans-unit.target: The chatbot on %1$s has reached its daily limit of %2$s messages.

trans-unit.source: The limit applies to all visitors together. Until it resets at %1$s, visitors see a notice that the daily limit has been reached and the chatbot does not answer.
trans-unit.target: The limit applies to all visitors together. Until it resets at %1$s, visitors see a notice that the daily limit has been reached and the chatbot does not answer.

trans-unit.source: If this is normal use, raise "Daily chat message limit" in the OpenAI configuration. If you did not expect this many messages, check the system log and the application log for unusual activity.
trans-unit.target: If this is normal use, raise "Daily chat message limit" in the OpenAI configuration. If you did not expect this many messages, check the system log and the application log for unusual activity.

trans-unit.source: You will receive this email at most once per day.
trans-unit.target: You will receive this email at most once per day.

trans-unit.source: This is a test email. Notifications for the chatbot on %1$s are set up correctly and reach this address.
trans-unit.target: This is a test email. Notifications for the chatbot on %1$s are set up correctly and reach this address.

trans-unit.source: OpenAI rejected the request because the OpenAI account has no credit or quota left.
trans-unit.target: OpenAI rejected the request because the OpenAI account has no credit or quota left.

trans-unit.source: Check the credit balance and billing settings of the OpenAI account that owns the API key.
trans-unit.target: Check the credit balance and billing settings of the OpenAI account that owns the API key.

trans-unit.source: OpenAI rejected the request because too many requests or tokens were sent in a short time (rate limit).
trans-unit.target: OpenAI rejected the request because too many requests or tokens were sent in a short time (rate limit).

trans-unit.source: This usually resolves itself within minutes. If it happens often, check the rate limits of the OpenAI account or project.
trans-unit.target: This usually resolves itself within minutes. If it happens often, check the rate limits of the OpenAI account or project.

trans-unit.source: OpenAI rejected the API key (invalid, revoked, or missing permissions).
trans-unit.target: OpenAI rejected the API key (invalid, revoked, or missing permissions).

trans-unit.source: Check the API key in the OpenAI configuration and test it with the key check button next to the field.
trans-unit.target: Check the API key in the OpenAI configuration and test it with the key check button next to the field.

trans-unit.source: OpenAI rejected the request as invalid, for example because of an unknown model or an invalid prompt setting.
trans-unit.target: OpenAI rejected the request as invalid, for example because of an unknown model or an invalid prompt setting.

trans-unit.source: Check the model and prompt settings in the OpenAI configuration. The application log contains the details.
trans-unit.target: Check the model and prompt settings in the OpenAI configuration. The application log contains the details.

trans-unit.source: OpenAI's servers returned an error or were temporarily unavailable.
trans-unit.target: OpenAI's servers returned an error or were temporarily unavailable.

trans-unit.source: Nothing needs to be changed on your side. Check the OpenAI status page (status.openai.com). The chatbot works again once OpenAI has recovered.
trans-unit.target: Nothing needs to be changed on your side. Check the OpenAI status page (status.openai.com). The chatbot works again once OpenAI has recovered.

trans-unit.source: The connection from this server to OpenAI failed or timed out.
trans-unit.target: The connection from this server to OpenAI failed or timed out.

trans-unit.source: If this persists, check the server's outgoing network connection and firewall. Occasional timeouts can also be caused by slow OpenAI responses.
trans-unit.target: If this persists, check the server's outgoing network connection and firewall. Occasional timeouts can also be caused by slow OpenAI responses.

trans-unit.source: OpenAI did not return a usable answer (the response was incomplete or empty).
trans-unit.target: OpenAI did not return a usable answer (the response was incomplete or empty).

trans-unit.source: This is usually a one-off. If it repeats, check the application log.
trans-unit.target: This is usually a one-off. If it repeats, check the application log.
